name: Christian Dior
description: House of Dior creates iconic couture fragrances rooted in French savoir-faire and pure raw materials from Grasse.

name: CHANEL
description: Legendary Parisian perfumery house celebrated for revolutionary elegance, timeless accords, and proprietary jasmine and rose fields.

name: House of Creed
description: Established in 1760, crafting aristocratic fragrances through time-honored infusion and millésime artisan techniques.

name: Tom Ford
description: Glamorous, provocative, and opulent perfumery engineered to captivate and command immediate distinction.

name: Maison Francis Kurkdjian
description: A prestigious Parisian atelier known for luminous olfactory architecture, crystalline sillage, and exquisite raw resins.

name: Yves Saint Laurent
description: Bold, rebellious Parisian luxury combining unexpected contrasts of Diva lavender and Moroccan orange blossom.

name: Versace
description: Italian haute couture perfumery celebrating Greek mythology, passionate citrus, and intense woody vibrance.

name: Giorgio Armani
description: Italian refinement capturing the elemental purity of the Mediterranean sea, mineral rocks, and volcanic woods.
